lines.text: Israel must destroy the nations' worship places and tear down their altars, smash their pillars, and burn their Asherah poles.
Israel must go to the place the LORD chooses from among all their tribes, and there they eat and rejoice.
After they cross the Euphrates, the LORD will give them rest from all the enemies around them.
Israel may slaughter and eat meat within any of their gates, but they must not eat the blood.
At the chosen place, Israel must rejoice with their households and with the Gershonite within their gates.
